subject: Vendor onboarding: remit instructions, portal delegation, and PO acceptance requirements
messages:
From: Emma Li <emma.li@cedartech.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 7 Jun 2027 08:14:00 -0400
Subject: New vendor onboarding — remit + PO requirements

Hi Sean,

Thanks for the quick call this morning. We need to get Redwood registered in our procurement system so your invoices will route to payment and tie to POs. To move forward we need: 

- Completed vendor onboarding form (attached)
- Remit details in CSV (bank, IBAN, SWIFT, remittance email) using our template OR vendor portal fields filled directly
- Proof of VAT/EORI for EU invoicing (company registration extract or VAT certificate)
- Confirmation of which invoice header to use so our AP can match PO lines (company name, billing addr, tax id)

A few specifics for CedarTech: we require PDFs that include the PO number on the first page and a separate line for tax/VAT when present. If you support e-invoicing (UBL/PEPPOL), we can accept that as well — please indicate capability.

I'll start the portal registration but I need one of your team to be delegated as the portal contact (coupa access) so we can complete the enrollment faster. Can Karthik or Laura be the main remit contact?

Attaching the AP packet and the remit CSV template. Once the portal invite is accepted, you can upload the documents directly to our vendor record.

Best,
Emma Li
Senior Procurement Specialist
CedarTech Ltd.

Attachments: cedartech-ap-onboarding-form.pdf
From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Li <emma.li@cedartech.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 7 Jun 2027 10:02:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: New vendor onboarding — remit + PO requirements

Hi Emma — thanks, received.

We can take the following steps this week:
1) I'll accept the Coupa invite and create the vendor record after Karthik confirms the banking details.
2) Laura will attach the VAT/EORI proof (PDF).
3) We will populate the remit CSV you provided and upload to the portal OR paste the bank fields into the Coupa form if your system prefers that.

Quick clarifications:
- Redwood's official invoicing header should be: Redwood Inference, Inc. | 123 Foundry St, Suite 400, Boston, MA 02110 | TAX ID: US-EIN-87-654321 (we will include EU VAT when the local entity invoices).
- Do you require a separate line for platform usage vs. subscription items, or is a single consolidated invoice line acceptable?
- For PO matching: is the PO number expected in the invoice filename or strictly in the invoice body? We can include both to be safe.

Karthik — can you confirm which bank account we'll provide (domestic USD vs. EUR IBAN)? If we provide USD with SWIFT vs. EUR IBAN, does CedarTech prefer local-currency payments for faster settlement?

I'll upload the remit template and a scanned VAT certificate to the shared doc once Karthik confirms.

Thanks,
Sean Gallagher
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
sean_gallagher@redwood.ai
+1 (617) 555-0124

To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 8 Jun 2027 09:11:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: New vendor onboarding — remit + PO requirements

Sean / Laura — quick note from finance on bank and VAT: 

- We will provide a EUR-denominated IBAN (Redwood EU Ops UG) for CedarTech EU invoices and a USD SWIFT account for North American settlements. Include both in the remit CSV and mark EUR as "preferred for EU invoices".
- VAT / EORI proof: attaching a scanned certificate for Redwood EU Ops and a company extract. Please upload eori-proof-scan.pdf to CedarTech portal.
- Invoice formatting: Finance requests line-level detail for usage-based charges (token usage) when the invoice exceeds EUR 10,000. For smaller invoices, a summarized line with PO number is fine.
- PO matching: CedarTech matching rules prefer the PO number in the invoice body and as an invoice-level field in Coupa. Filenames help but are not relied upon.
- E-invoicing: We can produce UBL XML but not PEPPOL right now. If Coupa accepts UBL, we can provide that as an alternative.

Laura — can you add the VAT cert to the packet and generate the remit CSV using the template attached by Emma? I will sign off and confirm bank routing by EOD.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Director, Finance (Revenue Ops)
Redwood Inference

> On Mon, Jun 7, 2027 at 10:02 AM Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai> wrote:
> > (reply preserved)
From: Emma Li <emma.li@cedartech.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
Cc: vendor-portal@coupa.com
Date: Wed, 9 Jun 2027 15:22:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: New vendor onboarding — remit + PO requirements

Sean / Karthik / Laura — thanks for the fast turnaround, we have everything we need to create the vendor record.

Next steps on our side:
- I'll send the Coupa invite to sean_gallagher@redwood.ai and to the delegated contact you choose. Please accept and complete the registration within 48 hours to avoid manual follow-up.
- I've opened the vendor record and attached your AP packet to the interim record; once you confirm the remit CSV upload we'll schedule the first test invoice clearance.
- DocuSign link for our supplier terms and tax self-cert is here: https://www.docusign.com/en/documents/DT-7809-registration. Please have the delegated signatory complete by Friday.

Note on payments: CedarTech issues EUR payments on a 30-day net schedule via SEPA when invoices are billed to CedarTech EU entities. For US invoices we process via ACH/SWIFT with standard domestic cutoffs. 

If you prefer, I can also escalate to AP operations to accept a one-time bank change memo to speed the first settlement. Let me know which bank (EUR IBAN or USD SWIFT) you want used for the first payment.

Best,
Emma Li
Procurement Specialist, CedarTech Ltd.

Attachments: (none additional)
